meta.title: Danger Zone
meta.description: The sudden appearance of a natural disaster.

units.rawText: On the beach, Copley Sector.
units.displayText: On the beach, Copley Sector.

spans.text: On the beach, Copley Sector.

units.rawText: A couple of uninvited guests have snuck their way in here at some point, like blots of ink that have suddenly appeared on a blank piece of paper, and they look exceptionally out of place.
units.displayText: A couple of uninvited guests have snuck their way in here at some point, like blots of ink that have suddenly appeared on a blank piece of paper, and they look exceptionally out of place.

spans.text: A couple of uninvited guests have snuck their way in here at some point, like blots of ink that have suddenly appeared on a blank piece of paper, and they look exceptionally out of place.

units.rawText: What's the matter, Hacchy? Why did you stop all of a sudden?
units.displayText: What's the matter, Hacchy? Why did you stop all of a sudden?

spans.text: What's the matter, Hacchy? Why did you stop all of a sudden?

units.rawText: Oh, is this place too hot? Want me to get you something?
units.displayText: Oh, is this place too hot? Want me to get you something?

spans.text: Oh, is this place too hot? Want me to get you something?

units.rawText: ...I'm fine. I appreciate the concern.
units.displayText: ...I'm fine. I appreciate the concern.

spans.text: ...I'm fine. I appreciate the concern.

units.rawText: It's just sunlight simulated with operands anyway. It's nothing compared to underground magma.
units.displayText: It's just sunlight simulated with operands anyway. It's nothing compared to underground magma.

spans.text: It's just sunlight simulated with operands anyway. It's nothing compared to underground magma.

units.rawText: It's all my fault for not preparing properly. I heard it was just an ecological research sector, so I headed right over.
units.displayText: It's all my fault for not preparing properly. I heard it was just an ecological research sector, so I headed right over.

spans.text: It's all my fault for not preparing properly. I heard it was just an ecological research sector, so I headed right over.

units.rawText: If I'd known the simulation would be so realistic, I would have brought a change of clothes...
units.displayText: If I'd known the simulation would be so realistic, I would have brought a change of clothes...

spans.text: If I'd known the simulation would be so realistic, I would have brought a change of clothes...

units.rawText: Protective clothing is essential equipment for going underground. Besides, I'm already used to it.
units.displayText: Protective clothing is essential equipment for going underground. Besides, I'm already used to it.

spans.text: Protective clothing is essential equipment for going underground. Besides, I'm already used to it.

units.rawText: Let's hurry and move out. Don't delay our mission.
units.displayText: Let's hurry and move out. Don't delay our mission.

spans.text: Let's hurry and move out. Don't delay our mission.

units.rawText: I hardly ever see you so worried, Hacchy... So you're worried about Succhy after all?
units.displayText: I hardly ever see you so worried, Hacchy... So you're worried about Succhy after all?

spans.text: I hardly ever see you so worried, Hacchy... So you're worried about Succhy after all?

units.rawText: He's always been a very capable kid, I'm sure he'll be fine.
units.displayText: He's always been a very capable kid, I'm sure he'll be fine.

spans.text: He's always been a very capable kid, I'm sure he'll be fine.

units.rawText: Hm...
units.displayText: Hm...

spans.text: Hm...

units.rawText: In any case, let's pick up the pace and head out, Hacchy! Relax and leave all the investigative work to me.
units.displayText: In any case, let's pick up the pace and head out, Hacchy! Relax and leave all the investigative work to me.

spans.text: In any case, let's pick up the pace and head out, Hacchy! Relax and leave all the investigative work to me.

units.rawText: I understand. Thank you.
units.displayText: I understand. Thank you.

spans.text: I understand. Thank you.

units.rawText: You should also be careful when you're by yourself. Take care not to clash with the Sector Administrator or the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: You should also be careful when you're by yourself. Take care not to clash with the Sector Administrator or the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: You should also be careful when you're by yourself. Take care not to clash with the Sector Administrator or the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Also... If circumstances permit—
units.displayText: Also... If circumstances permit—

spans.text: Also... If circumstances permit—

units.rawText: If circumstances permit, keep an eye on the <color=orange>"Objective"</color> that might appear, got it.
units.displayText: If circumstances permit, keep an eye on the "Objective" that might appear, got it.

spans.text: If circumstances permit, keep an eye on the
"Objective"
that might appear, got it.

units.rawText: After all, this is a special environment that hasn't been seen before. The "objective" that we've been looking for might be here.
units.displayText: After all, this is a special environment that hasn't been seen before. The "objective" that we've been looking for might be here.

spans.text: After all, this is a special environment that hasn't been seen before. The "objective" that we've been looking for might be here.

units.rawText: Relax. I won't forget our mission.
units.displayText: Relax. I won't forget our mission.

spans.text: Relax. I won't forget our mission.

units.rawText: <color=orange>[For Arcadia!]</color>
units.displayText: [For Arcadia!]

spans.text: [For Arcadia!]

units.rawText: >>CHAPTER 6 // DIVINE HERESY...
units.displayText: >>CHAPTER 6 // DIVINE HERESY...

spans.text: >>CHAPTER 6 // DIVINE HERESY...

units.rawText: ... We're here.
units.displayText: ... We're here.

spans.text: ... We're here.

units.rawText: This is the Copley Sector.
units.displayText: This is the Copley Sector.

spans.text: This is the Copley Sector.

units.rawText: I've checked again, and I'm sure the signal is coming from this sector.
units.displayText: I've checked again, and I'm sure the signal is coming from this sector.

spans.text: I've checked again, and I'm sure the signal is coming from this sector.

units.rawText: So Odile is here?
units.displayText: So Odile is here?

spans.text: So Odile is here?

units.rawText: Should be. I'll start cracking the firewall now—
units.displayText: Should be. I'll start cracking the firewall now—

spans.text: Should be. I'll start cracking the firewall now—

units.rawText: Wait, Antonina! We need to go about this cautiously.
units.displayText: Wait, Antonina! We need to go about this cautiously.

spans.text: Wait, Antonina! We need to go about this cautiously.

units.rawText: After all, back in the Pierides Sector, we were attacked by the Entropics the moment we tried to open the firewall.
units.displayText: After all, back in the Pierides Sector, we were attacked by the Entropics the moment we tried to open the firewall.

spans.text: After all, back in the Pierides Sector, we were attacked by the Entropics the moment we tried to open the firewall.

units.rawText: But we don't have much time. We didn't pursue Odile all the way here for revenge.
units.displayText: But we don't have much time. We didn't pursue Odile all the way here for revenge.

spans.text: But we don't have much time. We didn't pursue Odile all the way here for revenge.

units.rawText: Croque's more badly infected than any of us. We might not be able to solve the problem just by diving into her Tertiary Level.
units.displayText: Croque's more badly infected than any of us. We might not be able to solve the problem just by diving into her Tertiary Level.

spans.text: Croque's more badly infected than any of us. We might not be able to solve the problem just by diving into her Tertiary Level.

units.rawText: We still need the source code to completely eliminate the Entropic problem.
units.displayText: We still need the source code to completely eliminate the Entropic problem.

spans.text: We still need the source code to completely eliminate the Entropic problem.

units.rawText: Croque's condition has gotten worse ever since we returned to the Oasis from Pierides.
units.displayText: Croque's condition has gotten worse ever since we returned to the Oasis from Pierides.

spans.text: Croque's condition has gotten worse ever since we returned to the Oasis from Pierides.

units.rawText: The medical team is doing their best to save her, but all they can do is slow the infection down.
units.displayText: The medical team is doing their best to save her, but all they can do is slow the infection down.

spans.text: The medical team is doing their best to save her, but all they can do is slow the infection down.

units.rawText: We won't be able to make it if we don't attain the Entropy source code! We need to get our hands on a High-Order Entropic as soon as possible, dead or alive.
units.displayText: We won't be able to make it if we don't attain the Entropy source code! We need to get our hands on a High-Order Entropic as soon as possible, dead or alive.

spans.text: We won't be able to make it if we don't attain the Entropy source code! We need to get our hands on a High-Order Entropic as soon as possible, dead or alive.

units.rawText: But Anna... Persicaria has a point.
units.displayText: But Anna... Persicaria has a point.

spans.text: But Anna... Persicaria has a point.

units.rawText: The more urgent the situation, the less we can afford to make mistakes...
units.displayText: The more urgent the situation, the less we can afford to make mistakes...

spans.text: The more urgent the situation, the less we can afford to make mistakes...

options.rawText: It's not like you to be so hasty, Antonina.
options.displayText: It's not like you to be so hasty, Antonina.

spans.text: It's not like you to be so hasty, Antonina.

options.rawText: You seem to have gotten more mature, Sol.
options.displayText: You seem to have gotten more mature, Sol.

spans.text: You seem to have gotten more mature, Sol.

units.rawText: Tsk... Hearing you say that really pisses me off, Professor.
units.displayText: Tsk... Hearing you say that really pisses me off, Professor.

spans.text: Tsk... Hearing you say that really pisses me off, Professor.

units.rawText: Relax. I'm not THAT reckless.
units.displayText: Relax. I'm not THAT reckless.

spans.text: Relax. I'm not THAT reckless.

units.rawText: I just don't want those Entropics to get the better of me. After all, I AM an expert in computer virus research.
units.displayText: I just don't want those Entropics to get the better of me. After all, I AM an expert in computer virus research.

spans.text: I just don't want those Entropics to get the better of me. After all, I AM an expert in computer virus research.

units.rawText: Mature... Erm, is this really being mature?
units.displayText: Mature... Erm, is this really being mature?

spans.text: Mature... Erm, is this really being mature?

units.rawText: I just thought that we shouldn't hold everyone back because we're being impulsive.
units.displayText: I just thought that we shouldn't hold everyone back because we're being impulsive.

spans.text: I just thought that we shouldn't hold everyone back because we're being impulsive.

units.rawText: After all, Croque and the others...
units.displayText: After all, Croque and the others...

spans.text: After all, Croque and the others...

units.rawText: Anyway, enough of that! In any case, we'll find that "source code" and then we'll all go home safely!
units.displayText: Anyway, enough of that! In any case, we'll find that "source code" and then we'll all go home safely!

spans.text: Anyway, enough of that! In any case, we'll find that "source code" and then we'll all go home safely!

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: ...I know, Sol. <size=24>Why do I feel as if Sol and I have swapped roles...</size>
units.displayText: ...I know, Sol. Why do I feel as if Sol and I have swapped roles...

spans.text: ...I know, Sol.
Why do I feel as if Sol and I have swapped roles...

units.rawText: In any case, it's not like I was going to make contact with the firewall without any preparations.
units.displayText: In any case, it's not like I was going to make contact with the firewall without any preparations.

spans.text: In any case, it's not like I was going to make contact with the firewall without any preparations.

units.rawText: I've been researching the code structure of Entropy all this while. At least, when I'm cracking the firewall, I can see if there are any Entropics disguised as part of it.
units.displayText: I've been researching the code structure of Entropy all this while. At least, when I'm cracking the firewall, I can see if there are any Entropics disguised as part of it.

spans.text: I've been researching the code structure of Entropy all this while. At least, when I'm cracking the firewall, I can see if there are any Entropics disguised as part of it.

units.rawText: So what happened last time will not happen again.
units.displayText: So what happened last time will not happen again.

spans.text: So what happened last time will not happen again.

units.rawText: I see... Well, that's Anna for you!
units.displayText: I see... Well, that's Anna for you!

spans.text: I see... Well, that's Anna for you!

units.rawText: Sol relaxes and leans against the firewall.
units.displayText: Sol relaxes and leans against the firewall.

spans.text: Sol relaxes and leans against the firewall.

units.rawText: Well, we'd better hurry up and crack the firewall, then— urk!
units.displayText: Well, we'd better hurry up and crack the firewall, then— urk!

spans.text: Well, we'd better hurry up and crack the firewall, then— urk!

units.rawText: Sol!?
units.displayText: Sol!?

spans.text: Sol!?

units.rawText: As she leans against the firewall, Sol suddenly loses her support and is only spared the disgraceful fate of going ass over teakettle by her swift reflexes, which allow her to drop into a roll instead.
units.displayText: As she leans against the firewall, Sol suddenly loses her support and is only spared the disgraceful fate of going ass over teakettle by her swift reflexes, which allow her to drop into a roll instead.

spans.text: As she leans against the firewall, Sol suddenly loses her support and is only spared the disgraceful fate of going ass over teakettle by her swift reflexes, which allow her to drop into a roll instead.

units.rawText: Antonina's fingers dance over her keyboard. As we look at the firewall again, we see that the section which had been bearing Sol's weight has silently vanished in an instant.
units.displayText: Antonina's fingers dance over her keyboard. As we look at the firewall again, we see that the section which had been bearing Sol's weight has silently vanished in an instant.

spans.text: Antonina's fingers dance over her keyboard. As we look at the firewall again, we see that the section which had been bearing Sol's weight has silently vanished in an instant.

units.rawText: Are you alright?
units.displayText: Are you alright?

spans.text: Are you alright?

units.rawText: What... What the hell, Anna!?
units.displayText: What... What the hell, Anna!?

spans.text: What... What the hell, Anna!?

units.rawText: Didn't you ask me to open up the firewall ASAP?
units.displayText: Didn't you ask me to open up the firewall ASAP?

spans.text: Didn't you ask me to open up the firewall ASAP?

units.rawText: I did say that, but... but that was way too fast!
units.displayText: I did say that, but... but that was way too fast!

spans.text: I did say that, but... but that was way too fast!
Well done, Antonina!

options.rawText: How did you crack it so quickly?
options.displayText: How did you crack it so quickly?

spans.text: How did you crack it so quickly?

units.rawText: For some reason it sounds like sarcasm coming from you...
units.displayText: For some reason it sounds like sarcasm coming from you...

spans.text: For some reason it sounds like sarcasm coming from you...

units.rawText: Have your skills improved again, Antonina?
units.displayText: Have your skills improved again, Antonina?

spans.text: Have your skills improved again, Antonina?

units.rawText: I'm grateful for your rarely-given praise.
units.displayText: I'm grateful for your rarely-given praise.

spans.text: I'm grateful for your rarely-given praise.

units.rawText: And while I did speed things up a little... I can't take all the credit.
units.displayText: And while I did speed things up a little... I can't take all the credit.

spans.text: And while I did speed things up a little... I can't take all the credit.

units.rawText: The firewall here is exceptionally fragile, I can almost sense the lack of operands backing it up...
units.displayText: The firewall here is exceptionally fragile, I can almost sense the lack of operands backing it up...

spans.text: The firewall here is exceptionally fragile, I can almost sense the lack of operands backing it up...

units.rawText: Is it related to the fact that Copley is a private sector?
units.displayText: Is it related to the fact that Copley is a private sector?

spans.text: Is it related to the fact that Copley is a private sector?

units.rawText: The capacity of private sectors can't compare to those owned by big corporations.
units.displayText: The capacity of private sectors can't compare to those owned by big corporations.

spans.text: The capacity of private sectors can't compare to those owned by big corporations.

units.rawText: Hmm... perhaps.
units.displayText: Hmm... perhaps.

spans.text: Hmm... perhaps.

units.rawText: However, when you look inside the sector, they definitely don't seem to be lacking for operands.
units.displayText: However, when you look inside the sector, they definitely don't seem to be lacking for operands.

spans.text: However, when you look inside the sector, they definitely don't seem to be lacking for operands.

units.rawText: Sol, make sure you dust your hair off when you get up.
units.displayText: Sol, make sure you dust your hair off when you get up.

spans.text: Sol, make sure you dust your hair off when you get up.

units.rawText: Hm? Er, something seems to be sticking to my neck...
units.displayText: Hm? Er, something seems to be sticking to my neck...

spans.text: Hm? Er, something seems to be sticking to my neck...

units.rawText: ...Is that sand?
units.displayText: ...Is that sand?

spans.text: ...Is that sand?

units.rawText: After cracking the firewall, what appears before us is a scene that looks like it could have come from the real world.
units.displayText: After cracking the firewall, what appears before us is a scene that looks like it could have come from the real world.

spans.text: After cracking the firewall, what appears before us is a scene that looks like it could have come from the real world.

units.rawText:
The pale blue sky meets the deep blue sea as a straight line in the distance.
Dazzling sunlight shines down on the beach. It's hot but not scorching, filled with the life and passion of summer.
A gentle breeze blows through the shade cast by a nearby tree, as though to strum a traveler's heartstrings.

units.rawText: This... this is AWESOME!
units.displayText: This... this is AWESOME!

spans.text: This... this is AWESOME!

units.rawText: Did they simulate all this with operands? I find it a little hard to believe...
units.displayText: Did they simulate all this with operands? I find it a little hard to believe...

spans.text: Did they simulate all this with operands? I find it a little hard to believe...

units.rawText: Give me a few more seconds... Right, I've found the registration form data.
units.displayText: Give me a few more seconds... Right, I've found the registration form data.

spans.text: Give me a few more seconds... Right, I've found the registration form data.

units.rawText: This sector's listed purpose is—"Marine Ecological Research."
units.displayText: This sector's listed purpose is—"Marine Ecological Research."

spans.text: This sector's listed purpose is—"Marine Ecological Research."

units.rawText: So you're saying this is a sector for simulated ecological research?
units.displayText: So you're saying this is a sector for simulated ecological research?

spans.text: So you're saying this is a sector for simulated ecological research?

units.rawText: Pretty interesting, isn't it? Humans polluted the sea in reality, and now they can only reminisce about the past in the cloud server.
units.displayText: Pretty interesting, isn't it? Humans polluted the sea in reality, and now they can only reminisce about the past in the cloud server.

spans.text: Pretty interesting, isn't it? Humans polluted the sea in reality, and now they can only reminisce about the past in the cloud server.

units.rawText: The owner of this sector was probably an oceanographer from the previous century.
units.displayText: The owner of this sector was probably an oceanographer from the previous century.

spans.text: The owner of this sector was probably an oceanographer from the previous century.

units.rawText: But... there's no sign of Odile, is there?
units.displayText: But... there's no sign of Odile, is there?

spans.text: But... there's no sign of Odile, is there?

units.rawText: There's no sign of liquid Entropy on the beach either. Surely it hasn't all been washed away by the waves, has it?
units.displayText: There's no sign of liquid Entropy on the beach either. Surely it hasn't all been washed away by the waves, has it?

spans.text: There's no sign of liquid Entropy on the beach either. Surely it hasn't all been washed away by the waves, has it?

units.rawText: It doesn't matter, my tracker is still working. Let's keep moving.
units.displayText: It doesn't matter, my tracker is still working. Let's keep moving.

spans.text: It doesn't matter, my tracker is still working. Let's keep moving.

units.rawText: Ohhhh! Then let me be your guide!
units.displayText: Ohhhh! Then let me be your guide!

spans.text: Ohhhh! Then let me be your guide!

units.rawText: Just seeing this is making my blood boil with excitement!!
units.displayText: Just seeing this is making my blood boil with excitement!!

spans.text: Just seeing this is making my blood boil with excitement!!

units.rawText: Ow! Why'd you shout so suddenly?
units.displayText: Ow! Why'd you shout so suddenly?

spans.text: Ow! Why'd you shout so suddenly?

units.rawText: Erm, sorry about that. But Prof, Persicaria, Anna, aren't you guys excited about all this?
units.displayText: Erm, sorry about that. But Prof, Persicaria, Anna, aren't you guys excited about all this?

spans.text: Erm, sorry about that. But Prof, Persicaria, Anna, aren't you guys excited about all this?

units.rawText: This is the ocean, it's NATURE!
units.displayText: This is the ocean, it's NATURE!

spans.text: This is the ocean, it's NATURE!

units.rawText: Er... We know that...
units.displayText: Er... We know that...

spans.text: Er... We know that...

units.rawText: Finally, we've been freed from munching grass in some beat-up old power station, or squeezing up against some short-circuiting pillars!
units.displayText: Finally, we've been freed from munching grass in some beat-up old power station, or squeezing up against some short-circuiting pillars!

spans.text: Finally, we've been freed from munching grass in some beat-up old power station, or squeezing up against some short-circuiting pillars!

units.rawText: Have you forgotten? I'm a guide Doll for wilderness expeditions by profession.
units.displayText: Have you forgotten? I'm a guide Doll for wilderness expeditions by profession.

spans.text: Have you forgotten? I'm a guide Doll for wilderness expeditions by profession.

units.rawText: I'm back on my home turf! So can I lead the way? Can I, Prof?
units.displayText: I'm back on my home turf! So can I lead the way? Can I, Prof?

spans.text: I'm back on my home turf! So can I lead the way? Can I, Prof?

options.rawText: We'll be counting on you to be our powerhouse, Sol.
options.displayText: We'll be counting on you to be our powerhouse, Sol.

spans.text: We'll be counting on you to be our powerhouse, Sol.

options.rawText: We'll be counting on you to be our meat-shield, Sol.
options.displayText: We'll be counting on you to be our meat-shield, Sol.

spans.text: We'll be counting on you to be our meat-shield, Sol.

units.rawText: Leave it to me! This time... There won't be any problems!
units.displayText: Leave it to me! This time... There won't be any problems!

spans.text: Leave it to me! This time... There won't be any problems!

units.rawText: W-wait, a meat shield?
units.displayText: W-wait, a meat shield?

spans.text: W-wait, a meat shield?

units.rawText: Er, I'm probably not as tough as Croque or Aegis... But I'll do my best!
units.displayText: Er, I'm probably not as tough as Croque or Aegis... But I'll do my best!

spans.text: Er, I'm probably not as tough as Croque or Aegis... But I'll do my best!

units.rawText: Anna, is the signal coming from this direction?
units.displayText: Anna, is the signal coming from this direction?

spans.text: Anna, is the signal coming from this direction?

units.rawText: It's Antonina. Given the coordinates, that direction seems like the right one.
units.displayText: It's Antonina. Given the coordinates, that direction seems like the right one.

spans.text: It's Antonina. Given the coordinates, that direction seems like the right one.

units.rawText: OK. I'll blaze a trail while keeping an eye open for the Entropy and the Sanctifiers. Make sure you stay behind me, guys.
units.displayText: OK. I'll blaze a trail while keeping an eye open for the Entropy and the Sanctifiers. Make sure you stay behind me, guys.

spans.text: OK. I'll blaze a trail while keeping an eye open for the Entropy and the Sanctifiers. Make sure you stay behind me, guys.

units.rawText: Persicaria, are you alright?
units.displayText: Persicaria, are you alright?

spans.text: Persicaria, are you alright?

units.rawText: Oh, I get it now!
units.displayText: Oh, I get it now!

spans.text: Oh, I get it now!

units.rawText: So the stuff Sol said about eating grass was the Energy Herbs in the Helios Sector, and the short-circuiting pillars were the data arrays in the Enigma Sector...
units.displayText: So the stuff Sol said about eating grass was the Energy Herbs in the Helios Sector, and the short-circuiting pillars were the data arrays in the Enigma Sector...

spans.text: So the stuff Sol said about eating grass was the Energy Herbs in the Helios Sector, and the short-circuiting pillars were the data arrays in the Enigma Sector...

units.rawText: Persicaria, I think you really do need to rest...
units.displayText: Persicaria, I think you really do need to rest...

spans.text: Persicaria, I think you really do need to rest...

units.rawText: <size=26>Guys, look out for the Lesser Sanctifier patrolling at 10 o'clock. Stay as low as possible and quietly approach the Professor and me.</size>
units.displayText: Guys, look out for the Lesser Sanctifier patrolling at 10 o'clock. Stay as low as possible and quietly approach the Professor and me.

spans.text: Guys, look out for the Lesser Sanctifier patrolling at 10 o'clock. Stay as low as possible and quietly approach the Professor and me.

units.rawText: We were supposed to be very close to Odile's location, but her signal suddenly vanished just now.
units.displayText: We were supposed to be very close to Odile's location, but her signal suddenly vanished just now.

spans.text: We were supposed to be very close to Odile's location, but her signal suddenly vanished just now.

units.rawText: It vanished!?
units.displayText: It vanished!?

spans.text: It vanished!?

units.rawText: I can't be sure if it was because of environmental or artificial factors... I'll try to pick up the trail again, but it'll take time.
units.displayText: I can't be sure if it was because of environmental or artificial factors... I'll try to pick up the trail again, but it'll take time.

spans.text: I can't be sure if it was because of environmental or artificial factors... I'll try to pick up the trail again, but it'll take time.

units.rawText: Then we should take a break nearby. We might end up having to fight a tough battle afterwards.
units.displayText: Then we should take a break nearby. We might end up having to fight a tough battle afterwards.

spans.text: Then we should take a break nearby. We might end up having to fight a tough battle afterwards.

units.rawText: Don't stray too far from me, guys. Make sure you stay within view. The temperatures here are fairly high, so mind your thermal dissipation.
units.displayText: Don't stray too far from me, guys. Make sure you stay within view. The temperatures here are fairly high, so mind your thermal dissipation.

spans.text: Don't stray too far from me, guys. Make sure you stay within view. The temperatures here are fairly high, so mind your thermal dissipation.

units.rawText: You sure sound like a leader, Sol.
units.displayText: You sure sound like a leader, Sol.

spans.text: You sure sound like a leader, Sol.

units.rawText: Yeah, I thought we'd have to fight those Sanctifiers. Thank goodness we had you leading the way.
units.displayText: Yeah, I thought we'd have to fight those Sanctifiers. Thank goodness we had you leading the way.

spans.text: Yeah, I thought we'd have to fight those Sanctifiers. Thank goodness we had you leading the way.

units.rawText: Using the terrain to hinder vision... I didn't think we could evade Sanctifiers like that.
units.displayText: Using the terrain to hinder vision... I didn't think we could evade Sanctifiers like that.

spans.text: Using the terrain to hinder vision... I didn't think we could evade Sanctifiers like that.

units.rawText: Hehe, nah, I'm not all that great.
units.displayText: Hehe, nah, I'm not all that great.

spans.text: Hehe, nah, I'm not all that great.

units.rawText: Things went as well as they have because the only thing we've encountered so far are a few scattered Lesser Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Things went as well as they have because the only thing we've encountered so far are a few scattered Lesser Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Things went as well as they have because the only thing we've encountered so far are a few scattered Lesser Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: That DOES seem odd, though. We haven't seen any Intermediate Sanctifiers on our way in.
units.displayText: That DOES seem odd, though. We haven't seen any Intermediate Sanctifiers on our way in.

spans.text: That DOES seem odd, though. We haven't seen any Intermediate Sanctifiers on our way in.

units.rawText: These Sanctifiers' movement patterns seem quite uninspired. It doesn't seem like there's anyone directing them.
units.displayText: These Sanctifiers' movement patterns seem quite uninspired. It doesn't seem like there's anyone directing them.

spans.text: These Sanctifiers' movement patterns seem quite uninspired. It doesn't seem like there's anyone directing them.

units.rawText: Um... Could... could it be something like what happened in the Pierides Sector all over again...?
units.displayText: Um... Could... could it be something like what happened in the Pierides Sector all over again...?

spans.text: Um... Could... could it be something like what happened in the Pierides Sector all over again...?

units.rawText: I doubt it. At the very least, the Lesser Sanctifiers we've encountered so far haven't been Entropized, so even if there was an infection, it wouldn't be on the same scale as in the Pierides Sector.
units.displayText: I doubt it. At the very least, the Lesser Sanctifiers we've encountered so far haven't been Entropized, so even if there was an infection, it wouldn't be on the same scale as in the Pierides Sector.

spans.text: I doubt it. At the very least, the Lesser Sanctifiers we've encountered so far haven't been Entropized, so even if there was an infection, it wouldn't be on the same scale as in the Pierides Sector.

units.rawText: In any case, we ought to move quickly while we still haven't encountered an Intermediate Sanctifier.
units.displayText: In any case, we ought to move quickly while we still haven't encountered an Intermediate Sanctifier.

spans.text: In any case, we ought to move quickly while we still haven't encountered an Intermediate Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Antonina, how's the tracking going?
units.displayText: Antonina, how's the tracking going?

spans.text: Antonina, how's the tracking going?

units.rawText: Not good... I'm trying to reconnect to the signal, but I'm not picking it up at all.
units.displayText: Not good... I'm trying to reconnect to the signal, but I'm not picking it up at all.

spans.text: Not good... I'm trying to reconnect to the signal, but I'm not picking it up at all.

units.rawText: What!? Don't tell me the tracker was destroyed...
units.displayText: What!? Don't tell me the tracker was destroyed...

spans.text: What!? Don't tell me the tracker was destroyed...

units.rawText: Did Odile realize we were tracking her?
units.displayText: Did Odile realize we were tracking her?

spans.text: Did Odile realize we were tracking her?

units.rawText: Judging by the conditions under which the signal disappeared, I don't think the tracker was destroyed. It's more like she has entered a region where there is no signal.
units.displayText: Judging by the conditions under which the signal disappeared, I don't think the tracker was destroyed. It's more like she has entered a region where there is no signal.

spans.text: Judging by the conditions under which the signal disappeared, I don't think the tracker was destroyed. It's more like she has entered a region where there is no signal.

units.rawText: No signal... Now why would there be a region with no signal around here...?
units.displayText: No signal... Now why would there be a region with no signal around here...?

spans.text: No signal... Now why would there be a region with no signal around here...?

units.rawText: Don't panic, Antonina. Could the environment here be disrupting the signal?
units.displayText: Don't panic, Antonina. Could the environment here be disrupting the signal?

spans.text: Don't panic, Antonina. Could the environment here be disrupting the signal?

units.rawText: The sea...?
units.displayText: The sea...?

spans.text: The sea...?

units.rawText: Wait a minute, Persicaria. Your ears function like parabolic reflectors, so they should be sharper than ours.
units.displayText: Wait a minute, Persicaria. Your ears function like parabolic reflectors, so they should be sharper than ours.

spans.text: Wait a minute, Persicaria. Your ears function like parabolic reflectors, so they should be sharper than ours.

units.rawText: What kind of noise is it? Can you give a more specific description?
units.displayText: What kind of noise is it? Can you give a more specific description?

spans.text: What kind of noise is it? Can you give a more specific description?

units.rawText: It's kind of like a fizzing sound... A bit like bubbles in soft drinks.
units.displayText: It's kind of like a fizzing sound... A bit like bubbles in soft drinks.

spans.text: It's kind of like a fizzing sound... A bit like bubbles in soft drinks.

units.rawText: The sound of bubbles... on the sea...
units.displayText: The sound of bubbles... on the sea...

spans.text: The sound of bubbles... on the sea...

units.rawText: Sol looks toward the beach and her face suddenly blanches.
units.displayText: Sol looks toward the beach and her face suddenly blanches.

spans.text: Sol looks toward the beach and her face suddenly blanches.

units.rawText: The waterline that was just a few meters away from us has receded over a dozen meters away.
units.displayText: The waterline that was just a few meters away from us has receded over a dozen meters away.

spans.text: The waterline that was just a few meters away from us has receded over a dozen meters away.

units.rawText: The tide is receding... It's a tsunami!
units.displayText: The tide is receding... It's a tsunami!

spans.text: The tide is receding... It's a tsunami!

units.rawText: Right on cue, we feel a faint tremor coming towards us from the depths of the earth, steadily growing in intensity.
units.displayText: Right on cue, we feel a faint tremor coming towards us from the depths of the earth, steadily growing in intensity.

spans.text: Right on cue, we feel a faint tremor coming towards us from the depths of the earth, steadily growing in intensity.

units.rawText: <size=44>RUN!!!</size>
units.displayText: RUN!!!

spans.text: RUN!!!

units.rawText: Just then, an unexpected impact sends us all hurtling to the ground.
units.displayText: Just then, an unexpected impact sends us all hurtling to the ground.

spans.text: Just then, an unexpected impact sends us all hurtling to the ground.

units.rawText: Right after that, a massive wave of ice-cold seawater rushes toward us on the shore.
units.displayText: Right after that, a massive wave of ice-cold seawater rushes toward us on the shore.

spans.text: Right after that, a massive wave of ice-cold seawater rushes toward us on the shore.

units.rawText: <size=26>Roger.</size>
units.displayText: Roger.

spans.text: Roger.

units.rawText: <size=26>Got it...</size>
units.displayText: Got it...

spans.text: Got it...

units.rawText: <size=26>... Wait, what happened to the tracker's signal...!?</size>
units.displayText: ... Wait, what happened to the tracker's signal...!?

spans.text: ... Wait, what happened to the tracker's signal...!?

units.rawText: [Abnormal situation detected! Shifting movement route!]
units.displayText: [Abnormal situation detected! Shifting movement route!]

spans.text: [Abnormal situation detected! Shifting movement route!]

units.rawText: [Entering alert status!]
units.displayText: [Entering alert status!]

spans.text: [Entering alert status!]

units.rawText: Preparing to switch to combat mo...
units.displayText: Preparing to switch to combat mo...

spans.text: Preparing to switch to combat mo...

units.rawText: <size=26>Relax, they won't be able to spot us.</size>
units.displayText: Relax, they won't be able to spot us.

spans.text: Relax, they won't be able to spot us.

units.rawText: <size=26>But that Lesser Sanctifier's coming over...!</size>
units.displayText: But that Lesser Sanctifier's coming over...!

spans.text: But that Lesser Sanctifier's coming over...!

units.rawText: <size=26>It's safe over here! Move like I did just now and travel through the lower-lying region.</size>
units.displayText: It's safe over here! Move like I did just now and travel through the lower-lying region.

spans.text: It's safe over here! Move like I did just now and travel through the lower-lying region.

units.rawText: <size=26>Trust me.</size>
units.displayText: Trust me.

spans.text: Trust me.

units.rawText: Antonina returns Sol's steady gaze, then closes her terminal and slowly creeps toward Sol's location.
units.displayText: Antonina returns Sol's steady gaze, then closes her terminal and slowly creeps toward Sol's location.

spans.text: Antonina returns Sol's steady gaze, then closes her terminal and slowly creeps toward Sol's location.

units.rawText: That's right, stay low, use the terrain for cover...
units.displayText: That's right, stay low, use the terrain for cover...

spans.text: That's right, stay low, use the terrain for cover...

units.rawText: We remain still, not daring to make a single sound.
units.displayText: We remain still, not daring to make a single sound.

spans.text: We remain still, not daring to make a single sound.

units.rawText: The mechanical whirs of the Sanctifier's movements slowly draw closer.
units.displayText: The mechanical whirs of the Sanctifier's movements slowly draw closer.

spans.text: The mechanical whirs of the Sanctifier's movements slowly draw closer.

units.rawText: Whoosh...
units.displayText: Whoosh...

spans.text: Whoosh...

units.rawText: <size=26>Anna, over here!</size>
units.displayText: Anna, over here!

spans.text: Anna, over here!

units.rawText: A gust of wind blows, and the branch beside the Sanctifier rustles as it sways.
units.displayText: A gust of wind blows, and the branch beside the Sanctifier rustles as it sways.

spans.text: A gust of wind blows, and the branch beside the Sanctifier rustles as it sways.

units.rawText: The alerted Sanctifier changes direction, and Sol uses this opportunity to quickly grab Antonina's hand and pull her over.
units.displayText: The alerted Sanctifier changes direction, and Sol uses this opportunity to quickly grab Antonina's hand and pull her over.

spans.text: The alerted Sanctifier changes direction, and Sol uses this opportunity to quickly grab Antonina's hand and pull her over.

units.rawText: [Analyzing environment...]
units.displayText: [Analyzing environment...]

spans.text: [Analyzing environment...]

units.rawText: [Phenomenon determined to be part of normal sector operations.]
units.displayText: [Phenomenon determined to be part of normal sector operations.]

spans.text: [Phenomenon determined to be part of normal sector operations.]

units.rawText: [Report generated. Returning to pre-assigned patrol route.]
units.displayText: [Report generated. Returning to pre-assigned patrol route.]

spans.text: [Report generated. Returning to pre-assigned patrol route.]

units.rawText: We only dare breathe sighs of relief when the Sanctifier has moved far enough away.
units.displayText: We only dare breathe sighs of relief when the Sanctifier has moved far enough away.

spans.text: We only dare breathe sighs of relief when the Sanctifier has moved far enough away.

units.rawText: Whew... That scared the crap out of me...
units.displayText: Whew... That scared the crap out of me...

spans.text: Whew... That scared the crap out of me...

units.rawText: ...Thank you, Sol.
units.displayText: ...Thank you, Sol.

spans.text: ...Thank you, Sol.

units.rawText: Haha, it was nothing! Actually, we could have just fought it if things really didn't work out.
units.displayText: Haha, it was nothing! Actually, we could have just fought it if things really didn't work out.

spans.text: Haha, it was nothing! Actually, we could have just fought it if things really didn't work out.

units.rawText: Still, we'd trigger the security systems of this sector even if we beat it,  which would cause a lot of problems afterwards.
units.displayText: Still, we'd trigger the security systems of this sector even if we beat it,  which would cause a lot of problems afterwards.

spans.text: Still, we'd trigger the security systems of this sector even if we beat it,  which would cause a lot of problems afterwards.

units.rawText: If you hadn't taken the opportunity when the wind blew...
units.displayText: If you hadn't taken the opportunity when the wind blew...

spans.text: If you hadn't taken the opportunity when the wind blew...

units.rawText: I'm sorry, I really have been impatient lately.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, I really have been impatient lately.

spans.text: I'm sorry, I really have been impatient lately.

units.rawText: Aw, don't say that...
units.displayText: Aw, don't say that...

spans.text: Aw, don't say that...

units.rawText: ...It's trouble, all right. Specifically, it's Odile.
units.displayText: ...It's trouble, all right. Specifically, it's Odile.

spans.text: ...It's trouble, all right. Specifically, it's Odile.

units.rawText: Antonina's face turns severe as she mentions Odile's name. She opens her terminal again and shows us the glowing green screen.
units.displayText: Antonina's face turns severe as she mentions Odile's name. She opens her terminal again and shows us the glowing green screen.

spans.text: Antonina's face turns severe as she mentions Odile's name. She opens her terminal again and shows us the glowing green screen.

units.rawText: Right right right! It's very important to get enough rest outdoors!
units.displayText: Right right right! It's very important to get enough rest outdoors!

spans.text: Right right right! It's very important to get enough rest outdoors!

units.rawText: But back then with that Sanctifier... Your movements were so swift and certain because you expected the wind to pick up, right?
units.displayText: But back then with that Sanctifier... Your movements were so swift and certain because you expected the wind to pick up, right?

spans.text: But back then with that Sanctifier... Your movements were so swift and certain because you expected the wind to pick up, right?

units.rawText: Aw, it's just some knowledge that came with experience... Okay, that's enough. If you praise me any more it will start getting to my head.
units.displayText: Aw, it's just some knowledge that came with experience... Okay, that's enough. If you praise me any more it will start getting to my head.

spans.text: Aw, it's just some knowledge that came with experience... Okay, that's enough. If you praise me any more it will start getting to my head.

units.rawText: I can hear some noise from the sea, does it have anything to do with the signal's disappearance?
units.displayText: I can hear some noise from the sea, does it have anything to do with the signal's disappearance?

spans.text: I can hear some noise from the sea, does it have anything to do with the signal's disappearance?

units.rawText: No way!
units.displayText: No way!

spans.text: No way!

units.rawText: Fighting Lesser Sanctifiers like this is hardly a challenge now.
units.displayText: Fighting Lesser Sanctifiers like this is hardly a challenge now.

spans.text: Fighting Lesser Sanctifiers like this is hardly a challenge now.

units.rawText: Still, I can't believe Antonina lost her cool. Is there any trouble?
units.displayText: Still, I can't believe Antonina lost her cool. Is there any trouble?

spans.text: Still, I can't believe Antonina lost her cool. Is there any trouble?
